title: Model 3: no verified beach truth, so skill cannot be measured
scope: Attempt to build a second Model 3 benchmark from data on disk for 17 accepted beach geometries in the St Kitts and Nevis study area.
summary: The benchmark yields 1,003 site-by-pass cases: 0 positive, 37 filtered-empty and 966 unknown. The only available truth is the same satellite pass the prediction uses, which is circular, and none of 14,086 citizen reports fall in the study area. Model 3 skill is therefore Unknown, not zero. Dated beach presence or absence observations paired with forecasts frozen beforehand are required.
limitations: The source report is an untracked working-tree file; it is identified by SHA-256 only and has no source commit.
Satellite-pass truth is circular with the prediction, so even the 37 filtered-empty cases are not beach truth.
Beach geometry follows an east-facing rule on open map data, and earlier site coordinates were found to sit hundreds of metres from any accepted beach.
No recall, false-alarm or lead-time figure is claimed.
